beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The King of the universe is about to enter His own world. Watch HOW He chooses to arrive — because the method is the message.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Not a palace. Not a legion. A teenage girl in a hill town, engaged to a carpenter, says yes to heaven:

beats.speaker: woman
beats.text: Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to thy word.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Nine months later, in a stable behind a full inn, the Creator of galaxies drew His first breath in a feed trough — announced not to kings, but to night-shift shepherds:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: To ALL people — and heaven meant all. On the far side of the world, the other sheep received their own announcement, exactly as their prophets had promised:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And it came to pass that there was no darkness in all that night, but it was as light as though it was mid-day.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One birth. Two hemispheres. Both notified. Nobody's children get left off God's announcement list.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Now watch the enemy answer a baby. In Judea he moved a king to slaughter Bethlehem's infant sons. In America he flooded the land with a rumor — the signs meant nothing, believing was foolish. Swords on one side of the world, mockery on the other. Anything to smother the cradle.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It did not work. It never works. Joseph was warned in a dream and carried the child to Egypt. The believers held through the bright night. The cradle outlived both attacks.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There is a word for what God did in Bethlehem: condescension — the willing descent. Nephi was shown it centuries early, and an angel asked him the question of the ages:

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Knowest thou the condescension of God? And I said unto him: I know that he loveth his children; nevertheless, I do not know the meaning of all things.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: I know that He loves His children — I do not know the meaning of all things. That answer is still the finest theology ever spoken. And the condescension means this: God did not send a representative. He came. Small enough to be held. Poor enough to be overlooked. Vulnerable enough to be hunted.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The devil offers power that crushes. God arrived as weakness that saves. And a King who begins in a feed trough can meet you anywhere — there is no floor of your life lower than where He started.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So when life makes you small, remember how He chose to enter. The manger is not quaint. It is the whole strategy — love that walks in the door unarmed.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: He did not send a representative. He came — small enough to be held.
